source: docs/plans/roadmap.md, MVP coverage table; titles from docs/prd.md

mvp.title: Create a portfolio with properties, blocks and units in a three-level hierarchy
Unit types include chamber and hall, single room self-contained, 1 to 5 bedroom, studio, shop, store, office, warehouse, kiosk
Capture GhanaPost GPS address, region, district, MMDA and map pin per property
Attach photos, title or indenture, site plan and building permit to a property
Record ECG and Ghana Water meter numbers and meter type (prepaid, postpaid, shared) per unit
Unit status: vacant, occupied, reserved, under repair, not lettable, with a status history
Bulk import of properties and units from Excel
Amenities and features per unit (parking, borehole, generator, solar, air conditioning, furnished)

Tenant profile: individual or company, phone, WhatsApp number, email, occupation or business type; a tenant renting from several landlords on the platform signs in once and sees each tenancy, while each landlord sees only their own records
Ghana Card number capture and verification through an approved provider; passport for foreign nationals
Guarantor, next of kin and employer reference with contact details
Company tenants: registration number, TIN, authorised signatories, finance contact
Lease builder from templates (residential, commercial, short fixed-term) with editable clauses
Lease terms: start, end, rent, rent cycle (monthly, quarterly, 6-month, annual), deposit, service charge, escalation schedule, break clauses
E-signature of the lease by tenant, landlord and guarantor, with a signed PDF stored
Renewal workflow: reminder 90, 60 and 30 days before expiry; renewal offer sent as a signable link
Move-in condition report with timestamped photos signed by both parties
Move-out: notice, inspection, deposit deductions, final statement, refund
Invoices generated automatically from lease terms for each rent cycle
Cash and cheque recorded with receiver name, photo of receipt book or cheque, and manager approval
Partial payments, overpayments held as credit, and allocation rules (oldest debt first)
Arrears ageing: 0 to 30, 31 to 60, 61 to 90 and 90+ days, by tenant, property and owner
Security deposit held in a separate ledger, never mixed with rent income

Payment by MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, AT Money, bank transfer and card through a licensed aggregator, settled directly to the landlord's or agency's account; the provider fee is borne by the landlord or agency by default
Each tenant gets a unique payment reference; payments matched to the right invoice automatically
Payment links sent by WhatsApp, SMS and email; link shows amount due and lets the tenant pay part
Digital receipt issued within 1 minute of confirmed payment, sent on the tenant's channel
Reminder ladder: 7 days before due, on due date, 3, 7 and 14 days overdue; each step configurable
Unmatched payments queue for manual matching, with suggested matches
Record a lump-sum advance and spread it month by month over the period it covers
Show a "paid until" date to tenant, landlord and manager at all times
Track unearned rent as a liability in the owner's accounts
Calculate refund due if a tenancy ends early, net of agreed deductions; unused days of the current month are credited only where the lease provides for it

Record months paid in advance on every lease; a per-company setting (off by default, warn or block) decides whether residential advances above 6 months (Rent Act, section 25(5)) are flagged on the lease and in compliance reports
Renewal prompt when the paid-until date is 90 days away
Notice templates per type, with mandatory fields and lawful notice periods enforced
Secure link per recipient, expiring only after the notice period ends; no login needed, one-time code to sign
Tracking: sent, delivered, opened, signed, reminded, escalated, served, closed, each timestamped
Signed PDF with signature, timestamp, phone number verified, device details and document fingerprint
Automatic reminder ladder with pause and cancel controls
Commercial tenants: notice goes to every authorised signatory; one signature acknowledges for the company
Notices dashboard: open notices by status and days outstanding
Official WhatsApp Business Platform number per company (or a shared platform number for small landlords)
Inbound messages matched to the tenant by phone number; unknown numbers go to a triage queue
Menu bot for routine requests (balance, receipt, pay, repair) with handover to a person
Unified inbox: WhatsApp, SMS, email and in-app messages in one thread per tenant
Assign conversations to staff, tag them, set response time targets, alert on overdue replies
Approved message templates for reminders, receipts and notices (required by WhatsApp outside the 24-hour reply window)
Broadcast to a property, block or tenant group (water shutdown, fumigation) with delivery stats
Opt-in captured at onboarding; opt-out honoured; SMS fallback for tenants without WhatsApp
Email channel with inbound parsing (replies thread back to the record)
Repair messages create a maintenance ticket automatically, with media attached
Repair requests from tenant app, WhatsApp, caretaker app or manager, with photos, video or voice note
Priority levels (emergency, urgent, routine) with target response and completion times
Categories: plumbing, electrical, roofing, carpentry, painting, pest control, AC, generator, borehole, septic
Assign to an in-house person or an external artisan; artisan receives the job by WhatsApp link
Before and after photos required to close a job; tenant confirms completion
Inspections: routine, move-in, move-out, with room-by-room checklists and photos
Move-out inspection findings linked to deposit deductions with photo evidence
Double-entry ledger per owner and per property: rent, deposits, service charge, expenses, fees
Expense recording with receipts attached, categorised and allocated to property or unit
Management fee deducted automatically (a percentage of rent and service charge collected, including advances and excluding deposits, or a fixed amount per unit)
Monthly owner statement as PDF, with a cash section (collections, expenses, fees, tax, net remittance) and an accrual section (rent earned, unearned rent, deposits held, arrears), plus occupancy
Owner remittance tracking: amount, date, method, reference
Tax rates and rules held in configuration so changes in law need no code release
Rent tax calculated on every receipt: 8% residential, 15% commercial and non-residential
Rent tax due-date tracker: payment due within 30 days of rent received; alerts at 21 and 28 days
Record of GRA payments with receipts attached; rent tax report per owner
Withholding tax deducted by corporate tenants tracked against invoices, with certificate upload
Rent Control registration number and date per tenancy, with reminders until it is registered; rent collection is never blocked
Invoices and receipts with company name and TIN; VAT shown where it applies
Portfolio dashboard: occupancy, collection rate, arrears, rent roll, paid-until coverage
Lease expiry pipeline for the next 3, 6 and 12 months
Views filtered by owner, property, region and unit type; export to PDF and Excel
Company account (landlord or agency) with branding: logo, colours, sender name on messages and documents
Roles: owner, agency admin, property manager, accountant, caretaker, artisan, tenant, commercial tenant user, read-only adviser
Approval rules: two-person approval for notices to quit, refunds and write-offs; a landlord with no staff nominates a second approver, or re-confirms with a one-time code after 24 hours
Two-factor login; session timeout; device list with remote sign-out
Immutable audit log, searchable by user, record and date
Multi-owner setup for agencies: each owner sees only their own properties
Subscription and billing for the platform itself: tiers, per-unit rates by unit type, invoices, MoMo or card payment (section 21)
Platform admin console: company onboarding, support access with consent, usage and messaging costs
Every unit carries a billing band: single room, self-contained flat or house, or commercial
A unit counts as occupied whenever it has an active lease; a unit cannot be set to vacant while a lease is active, and every status change is logged
Monthly snapshot of occupied (billable) units by band, vacant units excluded, stored for audit and dispute
Rate card per tier and unit type held in configuration, with effective dates
Feature access controlled by tier; locked features show what upgrading unlocks
Tier minimum fee, proration, annual prepayment and discount codes
Subscription invoices and receipts in cedis; payment by MoMo or card; automatic renewal
Free trial or guided onboarding period: 30 days by default, length configurable
Subscription renews monthly until the landlord cancels; cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid cycle, with data export offered
Unpaid subscription invoices tracked as arrears with reminders to the landlord; tenant payment links, receipts and notices are never switched off
Tasks from the notice escalation ladder (in-person reminders, physical service record); handled in the manager web app until the field app ships
mvp.note: P2 in the PRD; the manager web app's tasks are in the MVP (roadmap, M7)

nfr.requirement: Key screens load in under 3 seconds on a 3G connection; tenant pages under 1 MB

evidence.runBy: .github/workflows/ci.yml, e2e job, step "Lighthouse budgets" (every pull request)
evidence.what: Lighthouse budgets for every links page and the tenant web app over 3G: under 1 MB, LCP under 3 s, layout shift under 0.1 (decision 8)

nfr.requirement: 99.5% monthly uptime; payment callbacks retried and never lost
Android 8 and above, iOS 16.4 and above, modern browsers; tenant app usable on 5-inch screens

evidence.runBy: people, by its written script: emulator and simulator runs, and two real phones (decision 11)
evidence.what: Android 8 and iOS 16.4 runs of the tenant app, 5-inch screens

nfr.requirement: Offline tolerant tenant flows (the caretaker app's 7 days offline is Phase 2)

evidence.what: the tenant app's offline cache, checked on devices

nfr.requirement: Encryption in transit and at rest; two-factor login for owners, managers and accountants; role-based access

evidence.what: the ASVS level 2 review, with no high or medium finding open

nfr.requirement: Act 843; consent for WhatsApp and SMS; defined retention; tenant data export and deletion on request

evidence.what: the Act 843 checklist and records of processing

nfr.requirement: Immutable log of financial entries, notice events, lease changes and permission changes
Agencies with 5,000+ units and 50+ staff without redesign

evidence.what: the month-end load test: 5,000 units, 50 staff, 2,500 payments in an hour, with the pass criteria of decision 7

evidence.runBy: .github/workflows/ci.yml, job speed (advisory, every pull request, RENT_SPEED=1)
evidence.what: the dashboard and rollup at 5,000 units

evidence.runBy: .github/workflows/ci.yml, job speed (advisory, every pull request, RENT_SPEED=1)

nfr.requirement: Currency, tax rates, ID types, address format and notice periods configurable per country
Daily backups, point-in-time recovery for 30 days, tested restore every quarter

evidence.what: dump, restore and verify every audit chain in the copy
restore drill: row counts and every nightly check on the copy
point-in-time recovery drill: base backup and WAL archive, recovery to a chosen moment, every nightly check

nfr.requirement: Tenant pages meet WCAG 2.2 AA where practical (M11 prompt)

evidence.what: the WCAG 2.2 AA checklist: keyboard, focus, targets, zoom, contrast, screen readers

evidenceRule: An NFR tag with no passing test is covered by its evidence when every evidence file exists (scripts/traceability.mjs). Evidence never counts for an MVP requirement: each needs a passing test.
